products.name: Command Large Caddy
products.query: Command Large Caddy clear 4 lb adhesive strips
products.summary: A small plastic caddy that sticks to smooth surfaces with Command strips. Roundups use it inside cabinet doors, under the sink or on a pantry door for cleaning supplies and reusable shopping totes.
products.renterNote: Suits a renter with light items (sponges, sprays, tote bags) and a smooth painted, tiled or finished surface; it is not for heavy loads, textured walls or humid spots, and the strips need the surface cleaned and time to set.
pros: Strip adhesive is designed to come off without damaging surfaces
Very low commitment, easy to move to a new spot
Fits inside cabinets and on doors where drilling is off limits
cons: Light rating only: sources give 4 lb for the large caddy, and one review mentions a separate 10 lb heavyweight version, so check the pack
Aggregator summaries mention some buyers seeing it fall off, mostly on textured, damp or poorly prepped surfaces

specs.mount: Command adhesive strips (4 in the pack, one review says 2 are enough)
specs.max load: 4 lb per the large caddy listing as cited by Apartment Therapy
specs.surface: Smooth only (painted wall, tile, finished wood, glass, metal)

products.scoreNote: Peel-and-stick install and strip removal score high; the 4 lb limit and surface fussiness hold it back from a 10.

praise: Easy tool-free install, and one reviewer fit four bottles and scrubbers under a kitchen sink
Could be repositioned with new strips without residue
complaints: Some buyers report it falling off, in one case in under a week, even after cleaning the wall and following instructions
Some would like wider compartments for larger items

sources.title: Apartment Therapy: Command Large Organizing Caddy review

products.name: Joseph Joseph CupboardStore 3-Container Hanging Dry Food Storage Set
products.query: Joseph Joseph CupboardStore under-shelf hanging dry food storage containers
products.summary: Three dry-food containers hang from a rail that clamps and sticks to the underside of a cabinet shelf, turning empty air under a shelf into storage for pasta, snacks or baking items.
products.renterNote: Suits a renter with a cupboard that has dead space under a shelf and dry goods to store; the key caveat is that the rail relies on adhesive (3M VHB per a retailer page), so test removal on a hidden spot and measure shelf thickness first.
pros: Uses wasted under-shelf space without screws
Slide-on clamps plus adhesive; retailer pages claim residue-free removal
Containers are sized for dry staples
cons: Retailer pages warn that ignoring installation steps can damage the product or shelf, and I found no independent proof of clean removal on painted or laminate shelves
Dry food only, hand wash, and listings disagree on container size (1.3 L vs 900 ml), so check the variant; a high price in the roundup

specs.mount: Clamps plus enclosed 3M VHB adhesive (retailer claim)
specs.fit: Minimum cupboard interior about W36 x D20 cm, max shelf thickness 2 cm (one retailer)

products.scoreNote: Needs shelf measuring and adhesive prep, removal is unproven on rental finishes, and it costs more than other picks.

products.name: Roysili Magnetic Spice Rack for Refrigerator, 4-Pack
products.query: Roysili magnetic spice rack for refrigerator 4 pack
products.summary: Magnetic metal shelves that cling to the side of a steel fridge, giving spices, oils or a paper towel roll a home with no adhesive and no holes.
products.renterNote: Suits a renter whose fridge has a magnetic side panel and a gap beside it; the key caveat is that it only works on steel, stated capacity varies by listing (5 to 8 lb), and a wide rack can crowd a narrow gap.
pros: Magnetic, so there is nothing to stick or remove
Moves with you to the next fridge
Sources say it needs no assembly
cons: Capacity figures conflict between listings (5 lb vs 8 lb), so plan around the lower one
Smooth magnets can slide on some fridge finishes when loaded with heavy glass jars

specs.pack: 4-pack with paper towel holder per Apartment Therapy; 2-packs also exist
specs.max load: 5-8 lb per shelf depending on listing

products.scoreNote: Nothing to install or remove, so it earns top marks there; only works on magnetic steel and the load rating is unclear.

praise: Magnets described as strong and not budging once placed
Named top overall pick among wall spice racks by Cuisine at Home, which says the magnet holds firmly on fridges and other metal

sources.title: Cuisine at Home: wall spice rack review
Apartment Therapy: Amazon magnetic spice rack review
